description: Public Route53 Hostname Not Covered by ALB HTTPS Listener Certificate
rationale: An observed public Route53 alias/CNAME points to the ALB, but no certificate in the verified HTTPS/443 SNI certificate list covers its hostname. Unseen DNS outside the account or partial ACM/listener inventory remains UNKNOWN.
remediation: Attach an appropriate SAN or single-label wildcard ACM certificate to the listener and verify the external TLS handshake.
